title: Hold a one-time price near VaultSweep's $24.99 with a clear value gap
rationale: VaultSweep sells one-time at $24.99 with no subscription and a 7-day trial. A one-time CacheDrop price well above this needs a visible reason; at or below it, the one-time pitch is table stakes rather than a differentiator.

title: Offer a trial at least as generous as 7 days
rationale: VaultSweep offers a free 7-day trial on a direct-only sale. Matching or exceeding it avoids a conversion disadvantage for buyers comparing the two.

title: Differentiate beyond developer/creative-pro cache cleanup
rationale: VaultSweep targets creative pros with Xcode/Logic Pro/Final Cut cache cleanup plus an uninstaller, and states it has no duplicate finder. CacheDrop could differentiate by serving a broader audience or by covering features VaultSweep lacks or does not state (duplicates, disk map).
